1_executive_summary: P-27 — Shape-Memory Polymer Catheter with Kink-Resistant Geometry. A computationally specified P-27 concept plus a preregistered decisive experiment — not a validated technology. Current evidence: T1. Transfer posture: DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT_REQUIRED. Recommended transaction: SPONSORED_VALIDATION ($18K bending + aging). Validation cost: $18K (includes accelerated aging).
2_industry_problem: NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. SMP fatigue over 5+ year implantation unknown. Helical geometry manufacturing feasibility not yet assessed.

3_current_alternative.strongest_alternative: Reinforced silicone catheter (existing) — mechanical reinforcement but no active kink recovery

4_technology_advantage_hypothesis.hypothesis: Materials solution to kink failure — platform for all catheters
evidence_against: NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. SMP fatigue over 5+ year implantation unknown. Helical geometry manufacturing feasibility not yet assessed.
4_technology_advantage_hypothesis.unresolved_question: Does SMP maintain recovery force after 5+ years at 37°C? Can helical geometry be manufactured at catheter scale (1-2mm ID)?

5_evidence_level.honest_assessment: Computationally supported. No external validation yet. Evidence ledger is transparent and auditable.

7_validation_investment.timeline: 14 weeks to T2, 12-18 months to T3
7_validation_investment.success_threshold: Advance to next development phase (see Development Plan)
7_validation_investment.t2_conversion_path: Current T1 → $$18K (includes accelerated aging) experiment → T2-CONDITIONAL

8_strategic_buyer_fit.ideal_buyer: Catheter OEM (Medtronic, Integra, Codman) or shape-memory polymer company
8_strategic_buyer_fit.buyer_type: Catheter OEM with advanced materials capability
8_strategic_buyer_fit.strategic_reason: Kinking causes 8% of catheter failures. Helical SMP geometry with active kink recovery is a materials-based solution. Could extend to other catheter applications (vascular, neurovascular).
8_strategic_buyer_fit.capabilities_required: Shape-memory polymer processing, catheter extrusion, accelerated aging testing
8_strategic_buyer_fit.why_this_buyer_would_care: Materials solution to a mechanical failure mode. Platform technology — kink resistance applies beyond shunts. The accelerated aging test is the decisive question.

10_why_now: Kink resistance via shape-memory polymer is a materials solution to a mechanical failure. Platform technology — applies to vascular, neurovascular, and shunt catheters. SMP processing has matured. Aging test is decisive. New candidate (R347).
